scripts.check:mobile: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint && npm --prefix mobile run test:unit && npm --prefix mobile run doctor
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web-admin run typecheck && npm --prefix web-admin run lint && npm --prefix web-admin run build
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:mobile && npm run check:web
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,AI,WEB,MOBILE" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm --prefix web-admin run dev" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,AI,MOBILE" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,WEB" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix web-admin run dev"
scripts.mobile:only: node scripts/android-reverse.mjs --optional && concurrently -k -n "AI,MOBILE" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:ai" "npm --prefix mobile start"
